articles.title: Construction of New Play Area at Mainway Meadows in Alkrington Underway
articles.excerpt: Rochdale Council has commenced work on a new play area at Mainway Meadows in Alkrington, Middleton, alongside improvements to two existing play areas, with completion expected in four to five weeks.
articles.content_html:
Rochdale Council has begun construction of a new play area at Mainway Meadows, located between Mainway and Moss Way in Alkrington, Middleton. This project aims to create an inclusive space for children of various ages and abilities, featuring accessible pathways, safety fencing, and a range of play equipment including swings, a slide, seesaw, roundabout, seating, and a children’s picnic table.

The construction of the Mainway Meadows play area is expected to take four to five weeks. This initiative is funded by Middleton Township, which aims to enhance local play facilities and provide a safe environment for families in the community.

In addition to the new play area, improvements are nearing completion at the Sandy Park play area in Alkrington. Councillor Dylan Williams expressed enthusiasm about the new equipment being installed at Kirkway Stocks Play Park, also known as Farmway or Sandy Park, highlighting the council's investment in local recreational facilities.

These developments are part of Rochdale Council's ongoing commitment to improving community spaces and ensuring that children have access to safe and enjoyable play areas. Local families can look forward to the completion of these projects, which will enhance recreational opportunities in the area.
